referenceName: Stoebe & Co.: boutique market atlas and property-search panel

source.name: Stoebe & Co. official website
source.sourceType: official direct real estate brokerage website captured in Playwright Chromium
source.rightsEvidence: Requester-attested clearance dated 2026-09-29 covers internal desktop and mobile screenshot retention, derived design prompts, and pipeline-model reference use. No source-owner grant was supplied or independently verified.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A thin framed utility header leads into an asymmetrical home-photo cover with a small wordmark and tightly set promise. A floating white address-search surface interrupts the opening before a sparse proof-and-philosophy chapter. The page changes into a classified market atlas, a mobile-product demonstration, a short testimonial interlude, then property listings, a high-impact seller image, regional tiles, editorial social content, and a compact inquiry. Its visual language is warm, restrained, serif-led, and notably spacious. Do not transfer the source's property imagery, geography, people, brand, listing facts, statistics, wording, testimonials, or exact palette.

heroGeometry.alignment: offset serif statement in a light wedge against an architectural photograph
heroGeometry.viewport: pair a clear estate-market identity with a floating search action before extended explanation

navigationGeometry.placement: slim rounded-outline rail above the image cover
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact brand and menu control with property search kept reachable

typography.scale: quiet oversized market headings, micro labels, short supporting paragraphs

palette.contrastIntent: restrained premium contrast with strong text legibility and clear controls

imageTreatment.mode: warm interior and listing editorial collage
imageTreatment.crop: wide residential cover, then small market tiles and listing thumbnails
imageTreatment.focalPoint: architectural light and home detail rather than embedded copy or identifiable source people

servicePresentation.interaction: separate buyer, seller, rental, commercial, and regional pathways before showing listings

ctaPlacement.primary: search by address, neighborhood, or client intent
ctaPlacement.early: floating property search between cover and brokerage story

motion.library: native overflow carousel with optional CSS transitions
motion.reducedMotion: show a fixed listing set and accessible previous and next buttons

mobileRecomposition.strategy: single column listing catalogue and compact region menu
rules: turn market tiles into a readable two-column or stacked index
keep property-search controls in the first decision sequence
stack property cards with readable location and key facts
preserve whitespace without making headings clip

prohibitedPatterns: copying Stoebe & Co. identity, logos, photography, property data, statistics, exact colors, testimonials, or copy
using its company or listing details as a client claim
converting the page into a uniform rounded-card wall
burying property search beneath a long brand essay
inventing client markets, rankings, transaction figures, or inventory

requiredSignatureElements.description: A search surface is visually distinct from and immediately follows the cover scene.
Audience or property-market categories form a browseable editorial index.
A mobile-facing product or search interaction is shown as a narrative chapter rather than a generic testimonial card.

acceptanceChecks: The opening moves from a property image into a usable search control.
Different client audiences or property categories remain separate pathways.
Property tiles show only client-approved facts and imagery.
The mobile treatment preserves search, category, and listing hierarchy.
All source property photography, wording, people, and numeric claims are excluded from client implementation.

compositionTopology.note: Screenshot shows overlapping layout mechanics; preserve the hybrid treatment rather than flattening it to this primary topology.

review.notes: Official home and About pages identify the independently owned Westhampton Beach brokerage, its market categories, team, listings, and contact routes. Full-page captures were inspected after rejecting non-essential cookies. No broken content images; the non-blocking missing Google Maps API console warning is recorded.
